baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ governs the result يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A right's becoming present specifically for them switches on directed arrival and compliant behavior; the compliance is therefore benefit-conditioned before any context is consulted.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in a time supply the conditional coming-into-force of the favorable state.
A right owned by its claimant supplies the advantage allocated to them and functions as the switch for approach.
Coming and arrival supply the observable movement toward the addressee once the condition is met.
Submission and tractable compliance supply the manner of arrival, making the favorable-condition response conspicuously frictionless.

changed_reading.before: They come submissively when truth is present.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival and submission are explicitly switched on when an enforceable advantage accrues to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: In لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ, the same focus noun can present fixed truth or a right belonging to a claimant, while لَهُم pulls the construction toward allocation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The truth and proprietary-right branches remain live together: the line does not merely ask whether a position is true, but exposes whether truth resolves in their favor. Their responsiveness is attached to the self-favoring face of truth.

activation_trace.role: Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the objective-merits reading that remains live.
A claimant's particular right supplies the allocated-interest reading sharpened by the dative pronoun.
Ready submission supplies the behavioral response whose selective attachment to favorable truth is being exposed.

changed_reading.before: They obey when they are correct.
changed_reading.after: They become responsive to truth precisely when truth takes the form of their own winning claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first fixes delimited obligations, repeatedly requires a claimant to bring witnesses, and uses the closely repeated construction in which witnesses are or are not 'for them.' This changes the focus right from a merely favorable opinion into a procedurally cognizable claim, and changes coming into an act of evidentiary production before authority.

activation_trace.role: The claimant-owned right supplies the focus entitlement whose procedural formation is sharpened by the earlier rules.
Arrival supplies the focus act now recast as presenting oneself and one's case to an adjudicating authority.
A precisely delimited imposition supplies the rule-bound legal environment in which a right becomes enforceable.
Bringing or producing something supplies the earlier procedural sense of the same root: a claim must arrive with evidence.
The presence or absence of witnesses in the repeated 'be for them' construction supplies a grammatical precursor to the focus condition.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the mechanism by which an asserted position can become a recognized right.

structural_cues: 24:1 declares the surah's norms imposed and delimited.
24:4 and 24:6 make production and configuration of testimony determine a claim's procedural standing.
The repeated ك و ن + لَهُم construction in 24:6 makes the focus conditional sound like part of the same legal grammar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed rules, required evidentiary production, and the repeated 'be for them' construction. I infer that these rules mediate how the focus right becomes actionable and how coming enacts a case. A live alternative is that 24:49 refers only to favorable merits, not formal admissibility.

changed_reading.before: They approach whenever they believe the truth favors them.
changed_reading.after: They readily submit to the forum when the rule-and-evidence structure has matured into an enforceable claim for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus points from 'the right for them' toward 'him,' but the wider surah names Allah as the manifest Truth, assigns Him sovereignty, makes Him the destination, and returns everyone to Him. The subjects reverse that hierarchy: their movement toward authority depends on truth first moving into their possession.

activation_trace.role: A particular right held by a claimant supplies the local possessive pole 'for them.'
Directed arrival supplies the focus vector whose motive changes under the wider ownership frame.
Fixed truth against falsehood supplies both the true due and the manifest Truth that exceed any litigant's favorable share.
Sovereignty supplies the encompassing ownership within which a private right is only a subordinate allocation.
Becoming toward an ultimate outcome supplies a destination independent of whether an interim judgment benefits them.
Return to a prior or governing point supplies the final direction that corrects their selfward orientation.

structural_cues: 24:25 places two uses of ٱلْحَقّ inside divine recompense and disclosure.
24:42 pairs divine sovereignty with movement toward Allah as destination.
24:64 closes with return to Him and disclosure of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contrast among a right 'for them,' Allah as Truth and sovereign, and movement or return to Him. I infer a reversal in motivational direction: they approach the authority only after truth points selfward. A live alternative is that these possessive and directional echoes provide theology without functioning as a critique of the focus pronouns.

changed_reading.before: Their fault is simply refusing an unfavorable verdict.
changed_reading.after: Their deeper inversion is to treat truth as authoritative only after it has become theirs, although ownership and destination in the surah run toward Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the dispute sequence, creatures worship in known patterns, birds align, all sovereignty has one destination, creatures move in their given modes, and guidance leads to a straight road. Against that ordered mobility, the focus subjects can move compliantly but let private advantage choose when their route activates.

activation_trace.role: Conditional occurrence supplies the unstable on-off condition governing these subjects' movement.
Arrival supplies the human movement compared with the stable courses established immediately before it.
Compliance supplies an available capacity for ordered motion that private interest selectively releases.
Worship through praise supplies a creation-wide pattern of responsive action rather than result-contingent participation.
Alignment on an even line supplies visible, stable ordering in bodily posture.
Universal sovereignty supplies the authority under which all these movements occur.
Movement toward an outcome supplies the stable destination against which self-favoring approach is measured.
Walking and bodily movement supply diverse but given modes of locomotion, each actually enacted.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies guidance not selected by a litigant's payoff.
The straight road supplies the invariant course immediately preceding the subjects' conditional approach.

structural_cues: 24:41-46 forms an extended sequence of known posture, destination, bodily movement, and guided road immediately before 24:47-49.
The focus result clause is also bodily and directional, but its protasis makes the route depend on private benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered creaturely action, a single destination, varied locomotion, and a straight guided road. I infer that this sequence makes the focus group's payoff-switched movement an ethical anti-pattern within ordered creation. A live alternative is that 24:41-46 only establishes divine power and guidance before the immediate courtroom polemic.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a local courtroom inconsistency.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also presents an anomalous mode of motion: these humans can move in compliance, but unlike the ordered courses around them, private benefit selects when they do.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence first opposes spoken belief and obedience to subsequent turning away, then rejects strenuous oaths in favor of recognizable obedience and divine knowledge of deeds. The focus complicates even that speech-action test: actual coming and submission can still be counterfeit evidence when their occurrence is perfectly aligned with self-interest.

activation_trace.role: Actual arrival supplies conduct that initially appears more probative than a verbal profession.
Visible compliance supplies enacted obedience whose motive the condition exposes.
Uttered speech supplies the profession of faith and obedience that later conduct tests.
Claimed obedience supplies the verbal category against which focus compliance is measured.
Turning away supplies the contradictory action that invalidates the preceding profession.
A formally apportioned oath supplies intensified speech that is nevertheless refused as proof.
Recognizable obedience supplies the demanded alternative to verbal insistence.
Knowledge of a matter's interior supplies scrutiny of motive beneath both statement and performance.
Intentional deed supplies the behavioral field known beyond their oaths.

structural_cues: 24:49 places genuine bodily approach inside an explicitly self-favoring condition.
24:53 refuses emphatic oaths and places known action under divine interior knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a progression from speech to contradictory action, then from oath to known deed. I infer a further diagnostic step: even an obedient-looking deed is inconclusive unless it survives adverse interest. A live alternative is that the focus coming is simply open hypocrisy and is not meant to revise the speech-action test itself.

changed_reading.before: Their words are false, while actual obedient conduct would reveal sincerity.
changed_reading.after: Even actual arrival and submission fail as evidence of sincerity when the action occurs only on the winning side of a dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: A summons to judgment produces side-turning refusal; the focus supplies the counterfactual condition under which the same group arrives submissively; the next ayah denies judicial bias as their excuse and identifies obstruction of right, while the following ayah defines faithful response as obedience to the same summons. The mechanism is selective acceptance of jurisdiction by expected outcome.

activation_trace.role: A claimant's owned right supplies the favorable expected disposition that controls participation.
Arrival supplies acceptance of the forum once its expected disposition favors them.
Ready submission supplies their low-resistance posture inside the favorable forum.
A call that draws by speech supplies the authoritative summons whose force they treat as optional.
Judgment between people supplies the institutional purpose of their approach or refusal.
Turning one's side away supplies the bodily refusal contrasted with the focus movement toward him.
Deviation in judgment supplies the proposed fairness-based excuse that the sequence rejects.
Withholding or obstructing a right supplies the sequence's diagnosis of the refusers rather than of the judge.
Obedience supplies the invariant response to summons that exposes their outcome-dependent substitute.

structural_cues: 24:48, 24:49, and 24:51 repeat summons or approach to the same adjudicating authority with sharply different responses.
24:50 explicitly tests and rejects fear of judicial deviation before assigning wrongdoing to the refusers.
The protasis of 24:49 isolates favorable entitlement as the variable that reverses refusal into submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, adjudication, refusal, favorable entitlement, denied fear of bias, and the obedient comparator. I infer that expected outcome, rather than confidence in forum fairness, controls their recognition of jurisdiction. A live alternative is that the ayah diagnoses broad hypocrisy without a narrower forum-selection mechanism.

changed_reading.after: They treat the adjudicating authority as binding only when it is expected to deliver their right, turning submission into outcome-contingent forum selection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, rightful mobility is reciprocal: do not enter without authorization, return openly when told, remain in a gathering until permission, and do not slip away under cover. The focus group's defect is thus not simple immobility; they approach openly when advantage invites them but do not accept authority over both entry and exit.

activation_trace.role: Coming supplies one direction of social movement whose legitimacy the context makes reciprocal.
Submission supplies the compliant manner that should govern adverse retreat as well as advantageous approach.
Entry into an interior supplies a concrete approach whose permissibility depends on another party's boundary.
Authorization supplies the external condition for rightful entry rather than a self-declared benefit.
Open return supplies compliant movement under an adverse answer, the behavior missing from the focus group's pattern.
A matter that gathers people supplies the shared obligation from which departure also requires authorization.
Repeated permission supplies accountable exit from collective duty and makes authority govern both directions.
Gentle hidden extraction supplies the covert opposite of accountable coming or return.
Using another as cover supplies concealment that turns departure into evasion of authority.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 regulates approach, entry, denial, and return around another party's boundary.
24:62-63 regulates remaining, licensed departure, and covert withdrawal around a collective matter.
24:49 supplies the inverse asymmetry: conspicuously easy approach only when the outcome belongs to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rules for authorized entry, obedient return, licensed departure, and concealed withdrawal. I infer a surah-wide ethics of reciprocal movement and read the focus as one-sided mobility under self-interest. A live alternative is that the household and assembly rules are parallel conduct domains rather than activators of the adjudication scene.

changed_reading.before: They fail by staying away from authority when a case may go against them.
changed_reading.after: They fail by recognizing authority over only the advantageous direction of movement: they come readily for gain but do not let permission and duty govern retreat, remaining, and exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it links two distant uses and different branches of ع ر ض: worldly share and turning one's side away. It remains valid as a cross-branch motion-and-payoff model anchored in لَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ, يَأْتُوا, and the immediate مُعْرِضُونَ. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory compass image, not claim that the two contextual uses are lexically identical or concern the same actors.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes advantageous possession govern movement toward him, while the preceding ayah describes bodily orientation away.

activation_trace.role: A right belonging to them supplies the payoff pole toward which their behavior turns.
Coming supplies the bodily vector activated when the payoff pole is favorable.
A transient worldly commodity or share supplies the material-interest pole of the exploratory compass.
Turning the side away supplies the opposite bodily vector when adjudication does not promise that interest.

changed_reading.before: They alternate between turning away and coming according to a favorable verdict.
changed_reading.after: Their bodily orientation acts like a compass for private share: expected gain turns them toward the forum, while its absence turns their side away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it imports the earlier mirage's appetite-driven approach into a legal scene. It remains anchored in the focus roots for owned right and coming, and in 24:39's explicit apparent water and arrival. Downstream prose must say that the analogy diagnoses the mover's expectation, not that a valid right, the authority, or the eventual judgment is itself unreal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A right becoming 'for them' is the perceived benefit that makes them come.

activation_trace.role: A claimant-owned right supplies the anticipated benefit that attracts movement.
Coming and arrival supply the focus motion recast as appetite-responsive approach.
A mirage shining like water supplies a perceived payoff capable of drawing motion before its reality is tested.
Ordinary water supplies the desired benefit projected onto the apparent destination.
Coming and reaching supply the contextual motion prompted by anticipated satisfaction.

changed_reading.before: Their coming proves only that they expect to win.
changed_reading.after: Their coming can be read as appetite-driven arrival toward a perceived benefit; it reveals what draws them, not an allegiance to truth independent of gain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it combines the focus branch of ح ق ق for a camel mature enough to carry with the compliant-camel scope of ذ ع ن, then lets 24:54's assigned burdens activate the image. It remains doubly anchored in focus branches and a nearby burden citation. Downstream prose should label it a material diagnostic image, never an etymological translation of ٱلْحَقّ or مُذْعِنِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins ٱلْحَقّ and مُذْعِنِينَ in a condition where the subjects become readily tractable only for a load that benefits them.

activation_trace.role: An animal reaching the stage fit for carrying supplies readiness to bear a load as the material image of a matured claim.
Tractable submission, including the branch's docile-mount scope, supplies the low-resistance carrier posture.
Bearing an assigned trust or burden supplies the nearby contrast: each party carries what is charged to it regardless of private payoff.

changed_reading.before: They are tractable when a right belongs to them.
changed_reading.after: In a contained burden-bearing image, they become an easy mount only when the load is their matured entitlement, while the surrounding command assigns burdens that must be carried without such advantage.

strongest_changes: The early evidence rules and repeated 'be for them' construction make ٱلْحَقّ a procedurally established entitlement and make coming an act of presenting a case.
The wider ownership and destination sequence exposes a possessive reversal: they move toward authority only after truth has first moved into their favor.
The immediate summons, judgment, refusal, and denied-bias sequence identifies outcome-contingent forum selection rather than principled fear of injustice.
The speech-and-oath sequence changes the diagnostic standard: even enacted submission is inconclusive when it occurs only under favorable interest.
The permission sequences make their fault one-sided mobility under authority, not mere failure to appear.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated exact grammatical and material links that a generic hypocrisy reading would flatten: ك و ن + لَهُم around witnesses and right, the evidentiary 'bringing' branch of ء ت ي, the shift from a right for them to Allah as Truth, owner, and destination, the two ع ر ض branches joining worldly share to bodily turning, and the contained camel-and-burden image across ح ق ق, ذ ع ن, and ح م ل.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus ٱلْحَقّ can continue to carry objective truth, favorable merits, and formally enforceable private right without forcing one sense to eliminate the others.
The referent of إِلَيْهِ is locally the summoned adjudicating authority, but the wider destination language can orient the reading without resolving the pronoun differently.
The creation-order and permission models are coherent whole-surah activations, but the immediate adjudication sequence remains the cleaner causal frame.
The ع ر ض, mirage, and burden-bearing outliers should remain qualified exploratory images rather than lexical claims.
